# A book whose entry rows use every column GnuCash's invoice and bill
# windows offer, so an export that drops one is a failing test rather than a
# silent loss.
#
# Most books never touch these: a discount, a note on a line, a bill line
# marked billable. That is exactly why they went missing — no fixture set
# them, so every writer could omit them and every test still passed.
#
# Every name and number here is invented.

2026-01-01 commodity CAD
	mnemonic: "CAD"
	fullname: "Canadian Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100

2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: Asset
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Accounts Receivable
	type: Accounts Receivable
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Liabilities
	type: Liability
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Liabilities:Accounts Payable
	type: Accounts Payable
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income:Sales
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Expenses
	type: Expense
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Expenses:Supplies
	type: Expense
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

customer "C-EVERY"
	name: "Every Field Ltd"
	currency: CAD

vendor "V-EVERY"
	name: "Every Field Supply"
	currency: CAD

# A discounted line, with the two choices that decide what the figure means:
# 10 per cent, taken before tax.
invoice "INV-EVERY-001"
	customer_id: "C-EVERY"
	currency: CAD
	date_opened: 2026-02-01
	entry:
		date: 2026-02-01
		description: "Consulting, February"
		action: "Hours"
		account: "Income:Sales"
		quantity: 10
		price: 100
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
		notes: "Agreed rate for the first quarter, per \"Schedule A\""
		discount: 10
		discount_type: percent
		discount_how: pretax
	posted:
		date: 2026-02-01
		due: 2026-03-03
		ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable"
		memo: "INV-EVERY-001"
		accumulate: true

# A bill line carrying an action, a note, and the two columns only a bill
# window has: billable, and how it was paid.
bill "BILL-EVERY-001"
	vendor_id: "V-EVERY"
	currency: CAD
	date_opened: 2026-02-05
	entry:
		date: 2026-02-05
		description: "Parts for the Henderson job"
		action: "Material"
		account: "Expenses:Supplies"
		quantity: 4
		price: 25
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
		notes: "Re-bill to the customer at cost"
		billable: true
		billable_to: "C-EVERY"
		payment_type: card
	posted:
		date: 2026-02-05
		due: 2026-03-07
		ap_account: "Liabilities:Accounts Payable"
		memo: "BILL-EVERY-001"
		accumulate: true
